WIC18A-01.note: Varve date 7,400 vs radiocarbon 8,100 for the same ash gives a correction; adjust. Bracket needs two tie points; cancel/compile weak.

WIC18A-02.note: Lake moderates frost risk in both seasons (warms in autumn, chills in spring), so cushion/buffer. Blanket fits only autumn warming; clock tempting from spring timing but autumn effect is protection, not timing. Cushion is a slightly loose fit for climate.

WIC18A-03.note: Costly signal: burns energy, gives up head start, weak gazelle cannot fake. Clear is the near-miss.

WIC18A-04.note: Rearing experiment shows tameness tracks predator exposure, i.e., circumstances. Appetite/anatomy struck on surface; company weak.

WIC18A-05.note: Grains locked in alignment record the field: captures. Boosts/bends fall on surface; alters slightly plausible physically.

WIC18A-06.note: Contrast with cleared estuary where tide carries silt away: roots trap/collect it. Absorb (roots absorb) and compact are near-misses; attract implies an active pull.

WIC18A-07.note: Figure from pooled colonies, real colonies range 28 to 33+, so it is an average. Boundary/capacity echo the threshold idea but are what 'particular colony's tolerance' contrasts with.

WIC18A-08.note: Worms eat through leaf layer, exposing forest floor: bares. Aerates is the strong garden-side lure; colonizes plausible but not what appetite does.

WIC18A-09.note: Species with outsized influence that holds the community together: anchor. Architect fits beavers (ecosystem engineers) and arguably the sea star structuring the shore, so a second defensible reading exists.

WIC18A-10.note: Predator replies with another species' delay, i.e., copies the signal. Block/corrupt weak; anticipate partially plausible.

WIC18B-01.note: Proportion of weights is a proxy undercut by the final sentence's caveats, so gauge (estimate). Determine and document overclaim; forecast wrong tense. Good near-miss item requiring the last sentence.

WIC18B-02.note: Neutral postcard raised turnout, and the effect persisted two years later with no prompting, so having voted (experience) sustains voting. Invitation is the strong near-miss; interest and duty refuted by content-free postcard.

WIC18B-03.note: Selling as a stove represents it can cook without stating it: implicit. Others weak.

WIC18B-04.note: Same offices, clerks, duties under the monarchy; only destination changed, so he inherited the system. Imitate near-miss but implies copying, not taking over; expand unsupported.

WIC18B-05.note: Final prices vary under 5% despite wide opening offers: unwritten but firm. Identical overclaims (5% variance); familiar/equitable unsupported.

WIC18B-06.note: Rumor causes withdrawals that create the shortage: generate (self-fulfilling). Fabricate is the lure (rumor invents it), hasten presumes shortage already coming; disclose opposite sense.

WIC18B-07.note: Day rates accurate but days worked unknown, so insufficient alone. Erroneous and inflated overclaim; dated weak.

WIC18B-08.note: Constant bias cancels in month-to-month comparison, so figures are informative for trends. Flawless overclaims; impartial contradicted by tilt; detailed unsupported.

WIC18B-09.note: Staged, gradual transmission: filters through. Drifts through is the near-miss; flickers/dissolves struck. 'through' favors filters collocationally.

WIC18B-10.note: Abandoning stock phrases gives the most direct (unmediated) evidence of feeling. Eloquent and dramatic are lures tied to warm language; extensive weak.

WIC18C-01.note: Notes fade in a second, so trills and repeats keep a line sounding: maintain. Phrase and polish (decorative) are lures; quicken weak.

WIC18C-02.note: Bigger windows didn't help; moving the room to face a garden did; eastern faces park, so the view (outlook). Lighting refuted, location refuted by same-building move. Requires combining sentences.

WIC18C-03.note: Director fixed the events and stopped drifting takes: improvisation was limited. Natural roughly opposite; masterful/mutual weak.

WIC18C-04.note: Actors lacked others' speeches and cues could come anywhere, so they had to monitor (listen to) every speech. Memorize is the lure excluded because they never had the text.

WIC18C-05.note: Phrases and verse forms first appear in letters, so letters are her most original/inventive writing. Lyrical and moving plausible-sounding but unsupported; 'original' slightly loose versus 'experimental'.

WIC18C-06.note: Concert performance lacked backdrops and machinery; critics wanted it staged: mount. Premiere excluded (premiered first season); license/orchestrate weak.

WIC18C-07.note: Choir sinks in pitch while staying internally in tune: pitch mismatches organ. Others unsupported.

WIC18C-08.note: Signature added later puts attribution to the painter in doubt: maker. Patron known from frame inscription; model was always unidentified, not newly questioned.

WIC18C-09.note: Night conveyed in dialogue, audience must imagine it: picture. Mimic/lament/predict weak.

WIC18C-10.note: Note-for-note borrowings woven in seamlessly: quoted. Parodied is the lure but harmonized faithfully and nothing sounds out of place; modernized/promoted weak.

WIC18D-01.note: Loanword vowel insertion decides between rule and accident: resolve. Sharpen near-miss; widen/revive weak.

WIC18D-02.note: Second clinic vaccinated far more people overall: reach. Thoroughness describes the first clinic (lure); thrift/staffing unsupported.

WIC18D-03.note: No wires snapped in six months, so quick-surfacing flaws can be excluded: rule out. Track down implies finding flaws (none found); sort out/smooth over weak.

WIC18D-04.note: Non-word on list almost never correct and slips rarely hit real words: method was sound (reliable) for that task. Simple is the lure; subtle/swift unsupported.

WIC18D-05.note: Parallel records expose silent errors before relying on software: test. Secure and tune plausible-sounding; streamline contradicted by doubled work.

WIC18D-06.note: High-frequency echoes from close structures return as distinct signals: separate (resolve). Target/survey weak; warm struck.

WIC18D-07.note: Under one sixth the tests at equal price found nearly as many cases: return per cost far greater. Scope was smaller (contradicts 'far greater'); share/rigor unsupported.

WIC18D-08.note: Words replaced slowly form a stable core used for comparisons. Vital/typical plausible-sounding but do not match slow replacement; social weak.

WIC18D-09.note: Added water keeps the ongoing reaction going: sustains. Triggers is the lure but the reaction starts at mixing; shields/tempers contradict 'makes the slab hard'.

WIC18D-10.note: Sign reminds staff of known fact at the key moment: refresh. Store/simplify/verify weak.
